```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(VariantAnnotation)
library(rtracklayer)
library(data.table)
```
# Read the GFF file
```{r}
gff <- import.gff("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/genomes/Araport11_GFF3_only_transposons_TAIR10_GFF3_genes.gff")

# Read the VCF file

vcf <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/pannagram/features/snp/snps_1_1_TAIR10_TAIR10.vcf", 
             select = c(1, 2),
             col.names = c("chr", "pos"))
vcf$chr <- gsub("TAIR10_", "", vcf$chr)
```

# Create 50bp windows at the start of each gene/TE based on strand
# For + strand: start position to start + 49
# For - strand: end position - 49 to end position
```{r}
snps <- GRanges(
  seqnames = vcf$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = vcf$pos, end = vcf$pos)
)

# Create 50bp windows at the start of each gene/TE based on strand
gff_50bp <- gff

# For + strand: start position to start + 49
start(gff_50bp[strand(gff_50bp) == "+"]) <- start(gff[strand(gff) == "+"])
end(gff_50bp[strand(gff_50bp) == "+"]) <- start(gff[strand(gff) == "+"]) + 49

# For - strand: end position - 49 to end position
start(gff_50bp[strand(gff_50bp) == "-"]) <- end(gff[strand(gff) == "-"]) - 49
end(gff_50bp[strand(gff_50bp) == "-"]) <- end(gff[strand(gff) == "-"])

# Count overlaps between SNPs and 50bp windows
snp_counts <- countOverlaps(gff_50bp, snps)

# Create result table
result <- data.frame(
  Chromosome = seqnames(gff),
  Start = start(gff),
  End = end(gff),
  Strand = strand(gff),
  Gene_ID = gff$ID,
  Window_Start = start(gff_50bp),
  Window_End = end(gff_50bp),
  SNP_count = snp_counts
)

# View results
head(result)

## Get the snp count 

```


## Pi calculation
```{r}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)


# Create 50bp windows
gff_50bp <- gff
start(gff_50bp[strand(gff_50bp) == "+"]) <- start(gff[strand(gff) == "+"])
end(gff_50bp[strand(gff_50bp) == "+"]) <- start(gff[strand(gff) == "+"]) + 49

start(gff_50bp[strand(gff_50bp) == "-"]) <- end(gff[strand(gff) == "-"]) - 49
end(gff_50bp[strand(gff_50bp) == "-"]) <- end(gff[strand(gff) == "-"])

# Create BED file (0-based coordinates for BED format)
bed <- data.frame(
  chr = as.character(seqnames(gff_50bp)),
  start = start(gff_50bp) - 1,  # BED is 0-based
  end = end(gff_50bp),
  gene_id = mcols(gff)$ID
)

write.table(bed, "windows_50bp.bed", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE)
```

```{bash}
vcftools --vcf snps_1_1_TAIR10_TAIR10.vcf \
  --bed windows_50bp.bed \
  --site-pi \
  --out gene_windows_sites
```
## Merge 
```{r}
library(data.table)

# Read vcftools output
pi_results <- fread("gene_windows_pi.windowed.pi")

# Read your original windows with gene IDs
windows <- fread("windows_50bp.bed", col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "gene_id"))

# Merge (vcftools uses 1-based coordinates in output)
windows[, start := start + 1]  # Convert back to 1-based
merged <- merge(windows, pi_results, by.x = c("chr", "start", "end"), 
                by.y = c("CHROM", "BIN_START", "BIN_END"), all.x = TRUE)

# Add original gene coordinates
gff_df <- data.frame(
  gene_id = mcols(gff)$ID,
  gene_start = start(gff),
  gene_end = end(gff),
  strand = as.character(strand(gff))
)

final_result <- merge(merged, gff_df, by = "gene_id")

fwrite(final_result, "gene_pi_50bp_windows.txt", sep="\t")
```
